messages:
kevin: Noticing a spike in GPU attach fails in asia-east1 starting 02:07 UTC — nodes showing NVMe avgq-sz > 60 and lots of 0-byte /tmp/scratch files.

ops-bot: [ALERT] nvme-avgq-high on gnode-ae1-*-pool (02:08:12 UTC) :warning:

mina: We pushed an aggressive janitor backoff change yesterday; did we also change fstrim cadence for this region?

kevin: We did bump fstrim to run more frequently to reduce long-term wear (change rolled 04:00 yesterday). suspect interaction with concurrent metadata rebalance.

frank: quick mitigation: pause janitor in affected pools and reduce fstrim frequency, cordon highest-latency hosts.

aya: pausing janitor on ae1-pool-3 now (02:11). running nvme error-log and SMART capture.

kevin: attach recovery started after pause — 39/42 retried successfully in 8m. filing RCA: small-delete storm + trim cadence + metadata rebalance -> write amplification -> firmware retries -> remounts/attach fails.

mina: schedule staged repro in ae1-staging with scrub_concurrency variations and janitor rate-limits. include cost model for cross-region autoscale ripple.
